description: Source code for the KubemarkController in Kubernetes, managing hollow nodes and node groups within a kubemark testing environment.

classes.name: KubemarkController
classes.description: Controller managing hollow nodes and node groups in a kubemark environment.

classes.name: externalCluster
classes.description: Handles communication with the external cluster hosting kubemark.

classes.name: kubemarkCluster
classes.description: Manages nodes within the kubemark cluster, including deletion and status checks.

methods.name: NewKubemarkController
methods.description: Creates a new KubemarkController with provided external and kubemark cluster clients.

methods.name: WaitForCacheSync
methods.description: Waits until all relevant caches are synchronized.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Initializes node template and starts node creation worker.

methods.name: GetNodeNamesForNodeGroup
methods.description: Returns list of node names in a specified node group.

methods.name: GetNodeGroupSize
methods.description: Returns current size of a node group.

methods.name: GetNodeGroupTargetSize
methods.description: Returns target size of a node group, including upcoming nodes.

methods.name: SetNodeGroupSize
methods.description: Adjusts the size of a node group by adding or removing nodes.

methods.name: GetNodeGroupForNode
methods.description: Returns the node group to which a node belongs.

methods.name: addNodeToNodeGroup
methods.description: Adds a new node to a specified node group.

methods.name: RemoveNodeFromNodeGroup
methods.description: Removes a node from a node group.

methods.name: getReplicationControllerByName
methods.description: Retrieves a replication controller by name.

methods.name: getNodeNameForPod
methods.description: Gets the node name associated with a pod.

methods.name: getNodeTemplate
methods.description: Constructs a node template based on existing hollow node.

methods.name: runNodeCreation
methods.description: Worker routine for creating nodes in the background.

methods.name: getHollowNodeName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a hollow node.

methods.name: removeUnneededNodes
methods.description: Removes nodes that are unready and marked for deletion.
